access.note: Private apps can be shared with any Pipedrive company by link without review; only a public Marketplace listing is reviewed

summary.setupEffort: About an hour of hands-on work (estimate, untested)
summary.waitOfficial: None for a private app. Optional Marketplace listing: reviews may take up to 21 business days (Pipedrive).
summary.nextAction: Log in to a Pipedrive developer sandbox account and open Developer Hub.

steps.title: Get a Pipedrive developer sandbox account
steps.detail: Composio has no managed Pipedrive app, so you need your own even for testing. Developer Hub is only available when you log in to a developer sandbox account.

steps.title: Create a private app in Developer Hub
steps.detail: Go to Settings → Developer Hub and save a draft private app; saving gives you the client ID and client secret. Private apps skip Marketplace review.

steps.title: Set the callback URL to Composio's
steps.detail: Pipedrive allows only one callback URL per app, so use Composio's redirect URI. It must work before you can make the app live.

steps.title: Pick scopes for what your agent does
steps.detail: Use :read scopes for a read-only agent and :full scopes only where it writes. The base scope is always on, and users accept or reject all requested scopes together.

steps.title: Create a Pipedrive auth config with your credentials
steps.detail: Create a custom OAuth2 auth config for the pipedrive toolkit with your client ID, secret and scopes, then pass its ID when you create sessions.

copyValues.label: TypeScript

steps.title: Connect from Composio, not from Pipedrive's Install and Test
steps.detail: Start the connection from the Composio Playground or a Connect Link and enter your Pipedrive company subdomain when asked. Pipedrive's own Install and Test button skips Composio's auth config.

blocker.cause: The app isn't live or available to that user's company, or the client ID and secret belong to a different app
blocker.fix: Check the auth config uses this app's client ID and secret, that the app is live, and that the callback URL matches, then start a fresh connection

steps.title: Make the app live and share its install link
steps.detail: Choose Change to live in Developer Hub; Pipedrive checks the callback URL, and live apps can't go back to draft. Then share the unlisted installation link from the app's menu with each company that will connect.

steps.title: Optional: list on the Pipedrive Marketplace
steps.detail: Only if you want customers to find you in the Marketplace. Public apps must use OAuth and pass Pipedrive's review, which needs test accounts and a demo video and may take up to 21 business days.

unknowns: Whether a customer's Pipedrive admin must approve installing your private app (not stated in Pipedrive's docs).
When Composio's managed Pipedrive app will be available; its FAQ says it's still under Pipedrive review.
Hands-on effort is an estimate and untested.

evidence.label: official
evidence.claim: You access Developer Hub by logging in to your developer sandbox account (Settings → Developer Hub); saving a draft app gives you the client ID and client secret.

evidence.label: official
evidence.claim: Live private apps can be shared with any company in Pipedrive via a direct, unlisted installation link; draft apps only within the same company. Only one callback URL is allowed per app, and it's validated when you click Change to live; live private apps can't revert to draft.

evidence.label: official
evidence.claim: The base scope is always enabled; deals:read reads deal data and deals:full creates, updates and deletes it; contacts scopes cover people and organizations; users accept or deny all requested scopes together, so request only what you need.

evidence.label: official
evidence.claim: Public app reviews may take up to 21 business days; Pipedrive tests install flows and functionality and asks for test accounts and a demo video explaining permissions and scopes; approved apps stay unlisted until you publish.

evidence.label: official
evidence.claim: Create the OAuth app in Pipedrive Developer Hub, then use its client ID and secret in a Pipedrive custom OAuth auth config. Pipedrive shows "App not found" when the app isn't approved or available for that user, or the auth config uses another app's credentials; start the connection from Composio and enter the subdomain, not from Pipedrive's Install and Test. The managed Pipedrive app is still under Pipedrive review.

evidence.label: official
evidence.claim: Composio's API lists https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add as the default OAuth redirect URI for the Pipedrive auth config, and no Composio-managed OAuth scheme for Pipedrive.
evidence.note: Also shown in the Composio dashboard when you create the auth config; use the dashboard value if they differ.
